metadata.header_path: Turn iPhone on or off
metadata.title: Use the side button to turn on iPhone. You can use the side button (along with either volume button on some models) or S

page_content:
Use the side button to turn on iPhone. You can use the side button (along with either volume button on some models) or Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bcf521514b7252cbb2d959.png) to turn off iPhone.
If your iPhone isn’t working as expected, you can try restarting it by turning it off, then turning it back on. If turning it off and on doesn’t fix the issue, try [forcing it to restart](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/force-restart-iphone-iph8903c3ee6/18.0/ios/18.0).

metadata.header_path: Turn iPhone on or off > Turn off iPhone
metadata.title: * _iPhone with Face ID:_ Simultaneously press and hold the side button and either volume button until the sliders appear

page_content:
* _iPhone with Face ID:_ Simultaneously press and hold the side button and either volume button until the sliders appear, then drag the Power Off slider.
* _iPhone with the Home button:_ Press and hold the side button, then drag the slider.
![Illustrations of two different iPhone models with the screens facing up. The leftmost illustration shows the volume up and volume down buttons on the left side of the device and the side button on the right. The rightmost illustration shows the side button on the right of the device.](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/922045a91e7a8c81b136a0061aecf43c.png)
* _All models:_ Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bcf521514b7252cbb2d959.png) > General > Shut Down, then drag the slider.  
**See also**[Force restart iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/force-restart-iphone-iph8903c3ee6/18.0/ios/18.0)
[ Previous Use Contact Key Verification ](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/iph654dd8c53/18.0/ios/18.0) [ Next Force restart iPhone ](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/iph8903c3ee6/18.0/ios/18.0)

metadata.header_path: Adjust the volume on iPhone
metadata.title: Adjust the volume of media, alerts, and sound effects using the volume buttons, Siri, or Control Center.

page_content: Adjust the volume of media, alerts, and sound effects using the volume buttons, Siri, or Control Center.

metadata.Header 2: Use the volume buttons or Siri to adjust volume
metadata.header_path: Adjust the volume on iPhone > Use the volume buttons or Siri to adjust volume
metadata.title: When you’re on a call or listening to songs, movies, or other media on iPhone, you can use the buttons on the side of yo

page_content:
When you’re on a call or listening to songs, movies, or other media on iPhone, you can use the buttons on the side of your device to adjust the audio volume. Otherwise, the buttons control the volume for the ringer, alerts, and other sound effects, unless the ringer and alert volumes are [locked in Settings](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/adjust-the-volume-iphb71f9b54d/18.0/ios/18.0#iphf02eb96e2).
You can also use Siri to turn the volume up or down.
**Siri:** Say something like: “Turn up the volume” or “Turn down the volume.” [Learn how to use Siri](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/use-siri-iph83aad8922/18.0/ios/18.0).
**WARNING:** For information about avoiding hearing loss, see [Important safety information for iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/important-safety-information-iph301fc905/18.0/ios/18.0).
![The upper portion of the front of iPhone with the volume up and volume down buttons on the upper left.](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/627625a141f7a1ba88d72b6c3c96465a.png)

metadata.Header 2: Lock the ringer and alert volumes in Settings
metadata.header_path: Adjust the volume on iPhone > Lock the ringer and alert volumes in Settings
metadata.title: 1. Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bc

page_content:
1. Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bcf521514b7252cbb2d959.png), then tap Sounds & Haptics.
2. Turn off Change with Buttons.

metadata.Header 2: Adjust the volume in Control Center
metadata.header_path: Adjust the volume on iPhone > Adjust the volume in Control Center
metadata.title: When iPhone is locked or when you’re using an app, you can adjust the volume in Control Center.

page_content:
When iPhone is locked or when you’re using an app, you can adjust the volume in Control Center.
[Open Control Center](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph7c412b4db/18.0/ios/18.0), then drag ![the volume slider](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/8acfabb27d34b0bd2faec597340d55e3.png).

metadata.header_path: Adjust the volume on iPhone > Reduce loud headphone sounds
metadata.title: You can limit the maximum volume of sound that plays through headphones on your iPhone.

page_content:
You can limit the maximum volume of sound that plays through headphones on your iPhone.
1. Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bcf521514b7252cbb2d959.png) > Sounds & Haptics > Headphone Safety.
2. Turn on Reduce Loud Audio, then drag the slider to specify the maximum volume.  
_Note:_ If you [set up Screen Time for a family member](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/set-schedules-with-screen-time-iphb0c7313c9/18.0/ios/18.0), you can prevent them from changing the Reduce Loud Audio level. Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bcf521514b7252cbb2d959.png) > Screen Time > Content & Privacy Restrictions, turn on Content & Privacy Restrictions, tap Reduce Loud Audio, then select Don’t Allow.

metadata.header_path: Adjust the volume on iPhone > Limit the speaker volume
metadata.title: With iOS 18.2 or later, you can limit the maximum volume of sound that plays through your iPhone’s built-in speaker.

page_content:
With iOS 18.2 or later, you can limit the maximum volume of sound that plays through your iPhone’s built-in speaker.
1. Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bcf521514b7252cbb2d959.png) > Sounds & Haptics > Volume Limit.
2. Turn on Limit Maximum Volume, then drag the slider to specify the maximum volume.  
_Note:_ If you [set up Screen Time for a family member](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/set-schedules-with-screen-time-iphb0c7313c9/18.0/ios/18.0), you can prevent them from changing the Speaker Volume Limit level. Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bcf521514b7252cbb2d959.png) > Screen Time > Content & Privacy Restrictions, turn on Content & Privacy Restrictions, tap Speaker Volume Limit, then select Don’t Allow.
**See also**[Change iPhone sounds and vibrations](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/change-sounds-and-vibrations-iph07c867f28/18.0/ios/18.0)

metadata.Header 1: Turn the iPhone flashlight on or off
metadata.Header 2: Use Siri to turn the flashlight on or off
metadata.header_path: Turn the iPhone flashlight on or off > Use Siri to turn the flashlight on or off
metadata.title: You can use Siri to turn the flashlight on or off.

page_content:
You can use Siri to turn the flashlight on or off.
For example, say something like “Siri, turn on the flashlight” or “Siri, turn off the flashlight.”

metadata.Header 1: Turn the iPhone flashlight on or off
metadata.Header 2: Use Control Center to turn the flashlight on or off
metadata.header_path: Turn the iPhone flashlight on or off > Use Control Center to turn the flashlight on or off
metadata.title: 1. [Open Control Center](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph7c412b4db/18.0/ios/18.0).

page_content:
1. [Open Control Center](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph7c412b4db/18.0/ios/18.0).
2. Tap ![the Flashlight button](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/48f7e5f108a6150bac9953378ca5741b.png) to turn the flashlight on; tap it again to turn it off.
_Note:_ If you don’t see ![the Flashlight button](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/48f7e5f108a6150bac9953378ca5741b.png) in Control Center, you can add it. See [Customize controls](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-control-center-iph59095ec58/18.0/ios/18.0#iph83c5f986c).

page_content: If your iPhone has ![the Flashlight button](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/48f7e5f108a6150bac9953378ca5741b.png) on the Lock Screen, you can press it to turn the flashlight on or off.

See [Use and customize the Action button](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-the-action-button-iphe89d61d66/18.0/ios/18.0).

metadata.title: After you turn on the flashlight, an image of the flashlight appears on the screen. You can change the brightness by dra

page_content:
After you turn on the flashlight, an image of the flashlight appears on the screen. You can change the brightness by dragging ![the Brightness button](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/c367090dd613218c425607e6f7dd2249.png) up or down on the flashlight image.

metadata.header_path: Silence iPhone
metadata.title: With the push of a button or flip of a switch, you can quickly silence your iPhone.

page_content: With the push of a button or flip of a switch, you can quickly silence your iPhone.

metadata.Header 2: Turn Silent mode on or off
metadata.header_path: Silence iPhone > Turn Silent mode on or off
metadata.title: When Silent mode is on, iPhone doesn’t ring or play alerts or other sound effects (but iPhone may still vibrate). When S

page_content:
When Silent mode is on, iPhone doesn’t ring or play alerts or other sound effects (but iPhone may still vibrate). When Silent mode is off, iPhone plays all sounds.
* On [models with an Action button](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph44c8b4227/18.0/ios/18.0): Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bcf521514b7252cbb2d959.png) > Sounds & Haptics, then turn Silent mode on or off.
You can also configure the Action button to turn Silent mode on or off, in addition to other functions. See [Use and customize the Action button on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-the-action-button-iphe89d61d66/18.0/ios/18.0).
* On other models: Flip the Ring/Silent switch toward the back of your iPhone to turn Silent mode on. Flip it toward the front to turn Silent mode off.  
**Important:** Clock alarms, audio apps such as Music, and many games play sounds through the built-in speaker, even when Silent mode is on. In some countries or regions, the sound effects for Camera, Voice Memos, and Emergency Alerts are played, even when the Ring/Silent switch is set to silent.

metadata.header_path: Silence iPhone > Turn on Do Not Disturb
metadata.title: You can temporarily silence calls, alerts, and notifications by turning on Do Not Disturb.

page_content:
You can temporarily silence calls, alerts, and notifications by turning on Do Not Disturb.
1. [Open Control Center](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph7c412b4db/18.0/ios/18.0).
2. Tap Focus, then tap Do Not Disturb.
When Do Not Disturb is turned on, you won’t hear ringtones or text tones for incoming calls, texts, or notifications. Also ![the Do Not Disturb icon](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/b26597fdb9cbbc61c9e6dd3789968f2a.png) appears in the [status bar](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/learn-the-meaning-of-the-status-icons-iphef7bb57dc/18.0/ios/18.0) at the top of the screen.  
See [Turn on or schedule a Focus](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/turn-a-focus-on-or-off-iph5c3f5b77b/18.0/ios/18.0).
[ Previous Turn the iPhone flashlight on or off ](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/iphf574afb44/18.0/ios/18.0) [ Next Open apps ](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/iphca3d8b4e3/18.0/ios/18.0)

metadata.header_path: Open apps on iPhone
metadata.title: You can quickly open apps from one of your Home Screen pages (like the one shown below) or your [App Library](https://su

page_content:
You can quickly open apps from one of your Home Screen pages (like the one shown below) or your [App Library](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/find-and-use-your-apps-in-app-library-iph87abad19a/18.0/ios/18.0).
![A screenshot showing an example of the default Home Screen that comes with iOS 18.](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/e5486dcf4a91009eb02814bd2abc9c42.png)
1. To go to the Home Screen, swipe up from the bottom edge of the screen (on an iPhone with Face ID) or press the Home button (on an iPhone with a Home button).
2. Swipe left to browse apps on other Home Screen pages.
3. Swipe left past all your Home Screen pages to see App Library, where your apps are organized by category.
4. To open an app, tap its icon.
5. To return to App Library, swipe up from the bottom edge of the screen (on an iPhone with Face ID) or press the Home button (on an iPhone with a Home button).

metadata.header_path: Open apps on iPhone
metadata.title: 4. To open an app, tap its icon.

page_content:
4. To open an app, tap its icon.
5. To return to App Library, swipe up from the bottom edge of the screen (on an iPhone with Face ID) or press the Home button (on an iPhone with a Home button).  
**See also**[Find your apps in App Library](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/find-and-use-your-apps-in-app-library-iph87abad19a/18.0/ios/18.0)[Quit and reopen an app](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/quit-and-reopen-an-app-iph83bfec492/18.0/ios/18.0)[Move and organize apps on your Home Screen](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/organize-your-apps-in-folders-iph822ece7dd/18.0/ios/18.0)[Remove or delete apps from iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/remove-or-delete-apps-iph248b543ca/18.0/ios/18.0)

metadata.Header 1: Switch between open apps on iPhone
metadata.header_path: Switch between open apps on iPhone
metadata.title: You can quickly switch from one open app to another on your iPhone. When you switch back, you can pick up right where yo

page_content: You can quickly switch from one open app to another on your iPhone. When you switch back, you can pick up right where you left off.

metadata.Header 1: Switch between open apps on iPhone
metadata.header_path: Switch between open apps on iPhone > Use the App Switcher
metadata.title: 1. To see all your open apps, do one of the following:

page_content:
1. To see all your open apps, do one of the following:
* _On an iPhone with Face ID:_ Swipe up from the bottom of the screen, pause in the center of the screen, then lift your finger.
* _On an iPhone with a Home button:_ Double-click the Home button.
2. To browse the open apps, swipe right, then tap the app you want to use.

metadata.Header 1: Quit and reopen an app on iPhone
metadata.header_path: Quit and reopen an app on iPhone
metadata.title: If an app isn’t responding, you can quit it and then reopen it to try and resolve the issue. (Typically, there’s no reas

page_content:
If an app isn’t responding, you can quit it and then reopen it to try and resolve the issue. (Typically, there’s no reason to quit an app; quitting it doesn’t save battery power, for example.)
1. To quit the app, [open the App Switcher](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph956b628e2/18.0/ios/18.0), swipe right to find the app, then swipe up on the app.
2. To reopen the app, [go to the Home Screen](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph808d22865/18.0/ios/18.0) (or [App Library](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/find-and-use-your-apps-in-app-library-iph87abad19a/18.0/ios/18.0#iph4a54323c7)), then tap the app.  
If quitting and reopening the app doesn’t resolve the issue, try restarting iPhone.
**See also**[Turn iPhone on or off](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/turn-iphone-on-or-off-iph841379c3d/18.0/ios/18.0)

metadata.header_path: Setup basics
metadata.title: iPhone has an easy setup process to help you get going when you first turn on your device. Whether you’re just getting s

page_content:
iPhone has an easy setup process to help you get going when you first turn on your device. Whether you’re just getting started or want to make sure you have the basics set up, you’re in the right place.
![The Quick Start screen, with options to set up your iPhone by bringing it close to another iPhone or iPad, or setting it up without another device.](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/09134278c8ef153570dfbe9d16f873b5.png)

metadata.Header 2: Transfer your apps and info onto your new iPhone
metadata.header_path: Setup basics > Transfer your apps and info onto your new iPhone
metadata.title: When you first turn on your iPhone and begin the setup process, you can wirelessly transfer many of your apps, settings,

page_content:
When you first turn on your iPhone and begin the setup process, you can wirelessly transfer many of your apps, settings, and content from your previous iPhone directly to your new iPhone—just bring the two devices close together, then follow the onscreen instructions.
![The Wi-Fi options screen in Settings. Wi-Fi is turned on, and a network is selected.](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/ce77a36725754282ae205c41d8de0bb4.png)

metadata.Header 2: Set up cellular service and connect to Wi-Fi
metadata.header_path: Setup basics > Set up cellular service and connect to Wi-Fi
metadata.title: Depending on your model, use an eSIM from your carrier or install a physical SIM card to connect to your cellular networ

page_content:
Depending on your model, use an eSIM from your carrier or install a physical SIM card to connect to your cellular network. To check if your iPhone is connected to your cellular plan, go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/610900798ec772fa266e98f9f6042807.png) > Cellular.
To connect your iPhone to your home Wi-Fi network, go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/610900798ec772fa266e98f9f6042807.png) > Wi-Fi, turn on Wi-Fi, then choose your network. iPhone automatically connects to your Wi-Fi network whenever you’re home.
![The Apple Account sign-in screen.](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/f7c44e11c57838574c23b823e7ff40f3.png)

metadata.Header 2: Sign in to your Apple Account
metadata.header_path: Setup basics > Sign in to your Apple Account
metadata.title: You use your Apple Account to access Apple services such as the App Store, the iTunes Store, Apple Books, Apple Music, F

page_content:
You use your Apple Account to access Apple services such as the App Store, the iTunes Store, Apple Books, Apple Music, FaceTime, iCloud, iMessage, and more.
To sign in to your Apple Account, go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/610900798ec772fa266e98f9f6042807.png) > Apple Account. If you have an iPad (with iPadOS 17 or later) or another iPhone (with iOS 17 or later), you can simply bring your iPhone near your other device. Otherwise, you can manually sign in. To verify that you’re signed in, go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/610900798ec772fa266e98f9f6042807.png) > [_your name_]; your Apple Account appears below your name.
![The Face ID recognition setup screen. A face is shown on the screen, enclosed in a circle. Text below the face instructs the user to move their head slowly to complete the circle.](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/cace01d17db166aba89026cb7cec39d4.png)

metadata.Header 2: Set up Face ID or Touch ID
metadata.header_path: Setup basics > Set up Face ID or Touch ID
metadata.title: You can use Face ID (face recognition) or Touch ID (your fingerprint) to securely unlock your iPhone, sign in to many ap

page_content:
You can use Face ID (face recognition) or Touch ID (your fingerprint) to securely unlock your iPhone, sign in to many apps, and make purchases. For your security, Face ID and Touch ID data doesn’t leave your device and isn’t saved anywhere else.
Depending on your iPhone model, do one of the following:
* _Set up Face ID:_ Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/610900798ec772fa266e98f9f6042807.png) > Face ID & Passcode, tap Set up Face ID, then follow the onscreen instructions.
* _Set up Touch ID:_ Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/610900798ec772fa266e98f9f6042807.png) > Touch ID & Passcode, tap Add a Fingerprint, then follow the onscreen instructions.  
![The Find My screen showing two devices at home.](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/094b05095e4101eed88bb41ceecc5e29.png)

metadata.header_path: Setup basics > Turn on Find My iPhone
metadata.title: You can locate your iPhone if it’s ever lost or stolen.

page_content:
You can locate your iPhone if it’s ever lost or stolen.
Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/610900798ec772fa266e98f9f6042807.png) > [_your name_] > Find My, tap Find My iPhone, then turn on Find My iPhone. You can see the location of your devices in the Find My app ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/3ef46077881e8558ba33ff4dc013dbbe.png). If you lose your iPhone and don’t have access to the Find My app, you can locate your device using Find My on iCloud.com.
![The iCloud settings screen showing the iCloud storage meter and a list of apps and features.](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/daefc0b2f02ab6b534fc32b8cdde6afc.png)

metadata.header_path: Setup basics > Store your data in iCloud
metadata.title: iCloud helps you keep your important info safe and in sync across your devices. If you replace or lose your iPhone, or i

page_content:
iCloud helps you keep your important info safe and in sync across your devices. If you replace or lose your iPhone, or it’s damaged or stolen, your photos, videos, and more remain secure in iCloud.
To turn on or change the features you want to use with iCloud, go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/610900798ec772fa266e98f9f6042807.png) > [_your name_] > iCloud.
Want to learn more?
* [Turn on and set up iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/turn-on-and-set-up-iphone-iph1fd7e482f/26/ios/26)
* [Set up cellular service on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/set-up-cellular-service-iph3f11fba92/26/ios/26)
* [Connect iPhone to the internet](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/connect-to-the-internet-iphd1cf4268/26/ios/26)
* [Set up Face ID on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/set-up-face-id-iph6d162927a/26/ios/26)
* [Locate a device in Find My on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/locate-a-device-iph09b087eda/26/ios/26)
* [Use iCloud on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/use-icloud-iphde0f868fd/26/ios/26)  
Not all features are available for all iPhone models.

metadata.title: You can assign distinctive ringtones to certain people, and turn the ringer on or off.

page_content: You can assign distinctive ringtones to certain people, and turn the ringer on or off.

metadata.Header 2: Assign a different ringtone to a contact
metadata.header_path: Select ringtones on iPhone > Assign a different ringtone to a contact
metadata.title: 1. Open the Contacts app ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/16b96

page_content:
1. Open the Contacts app ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/16b966e440ec5fb9278ce6235caabc74.png) on your iPhone.
2. Select a contact, tap Edit, tap Ringtone, then choose a ringtone.

metadata.Header 2: Turn the ringer on or off
metadata.header_path: Select ringtones on iPhone > Turn the ringer on or off
metadata.title: * On [supported models](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph44c8b4227/26/ios/26): [Open Control Center

page_content:
* On [supported models](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph44c8b4227/26/ios/26): [Open Control Center](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph7c412b4db/26/ios/26), then tap ![the Mute Switch button](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/b2b2f4cd52ef62e379f7b56d582279dc.png).
You can also configure the Action Button to turn the ringer on or off. See [Customize the Action button](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-the-action-button-iphe89d61d66/26/ios/26#iph7f3b44a7e).
* On other models: Flip the Ring/Silent switch to turn Silent mode on or off.  
Clock alarms still play when Silent mode is turned on.
To temporarily silence incoming calls, [turn on or schedule a Focus on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/turn-a-focus-on-or-off-iph5c3f5b77b/26/ios/26).
You can also change the default sound that plays when you receive a call, text, voicemail, email, reminder, or other notification. To learn more, see [Customize your iPhone sounds and vibrations](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/change-sounds-and-vibrations-iph07c867f28/26/ios/26#iph5c79226c7).

metadata.header_path: Change the wallpaper on iPhone
metadata.title: On iPhone, you can change the wallpaper on the Lock Screen and the Home Screen. You can set your wallpaper in Settings o

page_content:
On iPhone, you can change the wallpaper on the Lock Screen and the Home Screen. You can set your wallpaper in Settings or through the wallpaper gallery from your Lock Screen. See [Create a custom iPhone Lock Screen](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/create-a-custom-lock-screen-iph4d0e6c351/26/ios/26).
![The Wallpaper Settings screen, with buttons for customizing the current wallpaper on the Home Screen and Lock Screen, and the Add New Wallpaper button for changing the wallpaper.](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/6f16d306fed90be94d213cdd1687e7b9.png)
1. Go to the Settings app ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/610900798ec772fa266e98f9f6042807.png) on your iPhone.
2. Tap Wallpaper, then tap Add New Wallpaper.
3. Tap one of the wallpaper options, then make additional changes to the Lock Screen.
4. Tap Add, then do one of the following:
* _Choose to use the wallpaper on both the Lock Screen and Home Screen:_ Tap Set as Wallpaper Pair.
* _Make changes to the Home Screen:_ Tap Customize Home Screen. Tap a color to change the wallpaper color, tap ![the Photo On Rectangle button](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/b5bfd24869a69ca545847f0b0a3efe9a.png) to use a custom photo, or select Blur to blur the wallpaper so the apps stand out.

metadata.header_path: Add more homes with iPhone
metadata.title: In the Home app, you can add more than one physical space—a home and a small office, for example.

page_content:
In the Home app, you can add more than one physical space—a home and a small office, for example.
1. Go to the Home app ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/85f2372dec31f6ac14ebf1ec2cb92c5a.png) on your iPhone.
2. Tap ![the Add button](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/0d07cb7185e2d87af8a9ad8b4ace6995.png), then tap Add New Home.
3. Name the home, choose its wallpaper, then tap Save.
4. To switch to another home, tap ![the More button](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/2de35ce63d633769b9bfeb184c874452.png), then tap the home you want.  
**See also**[Set up accessories with Home on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/set-up-accessories-iph125110541/18.0/ios/18.0)
